description: This file provides polyfill implementations for Python built-in functions such as all, any, enumerate, sum, and custom iterator classes, with decorators for graph substitution.

classes.name: _CallableIterator
classes.description: Custom iterator class that calls a function until a sentinel value is returned.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Polyfill for the built-in all() function, checks if all elements in an iterable are true.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Polyfill for the built-in any() function, checks if any element in an iterable is true.

methods.name: enumerate
methods.description: Polyfill for the built-in enumerate() function, yields pairs of index and element starting from a given start value.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Polyfill for the built-in sum() function, sums elements of an iterable with an optional start value.

methods.name: _CallableIterator
methods.description: Iterator class that repeatedly calls a function until a sentinel value is returned.

methods.name: iter_
methods.description: Custom implementation of the iter() function supporting both iterable and callable with sentinel.
